## Overview

Explore Redmi Note 4: source-listed display, performance, battery and camera details, followed by practical checks before making a decision. This is a reference guide, not a new-launch report.

## Source-listed specifications

| Field | Source-listed detail |
| --- | --- |
| Manufacturer | Xiaomi |
| Display | 5.5 in (140 mm) IPS LCD capacitive touchscreen 1080 x 1920 pixels, ~401 ppi , 16M colors with 2.5D scratch resistant curved glass. Vendors: BOE, Tianma, EBBG (Late 2017 units onwards) |
| Processor | MediaTek Helio X20 Deca core (TSMC 20nm HKMG) Max. 2.1GHz (2x 2.1 GHz Cortex A72 + 4x 1.85 GHz Cortex A53 + 4x 1.4 GHz Cortex A53) MT6796 or Qualcomm Snapdragon 625 Octa core (14nm Samsung LPP FinFET) Max. 2.0 GHz (8x 2.0 GHz Cortex-A53) MSM8953 |
| Battery | Non-removable Li-Po 4100mAh(typ)4000mAh(min) battery |
| Ram | 16 GB, 32 GB or 64 GB eMMC 5.1 RAM: 2 GB, 3 GB or 4 GB LPDDR3 32-bit Single-Channel 933MHz |
| Cameras | 13 MP, Sony Exmor RS IMX258 or Samsung ISOCELL S5K3L8 or Omnivision Purecel OV18355 All sensors have: f/2.0, 0.1s ultra fast phase detection autofocus (PDAF), 1.12μm pixel size, CMOS BSI with dual-LED (dual tone) flash, 5-piece lens, 4K/4K UHD, 120fps slo-mo support. |
| Charging | 5V@2A (10W) via microUSB 2.0 Port |
| Connectivity | Wi-Fi 802.11 a/b/g/n/ac* Dual Band 2.4/5.0 GHz, Wi-Fi Direct , hotspot Bluetooth 4.1, A2DP, LE (* = Wi-Fi 802.11 ac band supported on MTK variant only) |
| Os | Redmi Note 4: MIUI 10.0 based on Android 6.0 Redmi Note 4 (SD)/4X: MIUI 11.0 based on Android 7.0 . |
| Front Camera | 5 MP Samsung ISOCELL S5K5E8 f/2.0, 1080p, face recognition support |
| Weight | 165 g (5.8 oz) (Snapdragon Variant) 175 g (6.2 oz) (MediaTek Variant) |
| Dimensions | dimensions: 151 mm (5.9 in) H 76 mm (3.0 in) W 8.45 mm (0.333 in) D |
| Compatible networks | GSM: 850/900/1800/1900 HSPA: 850 / 900 / 1900 / 2100 LTE: B3, B5, B40 (India Qualcomm) LTE Cat.6 2CA (50 mbps uplink, 300 mbps downlink) |
| Removable storage | microSD, up to 128 GB (uses SIM 2 slot) |

## How to compare specifications

Check the exact regional model, chipset, screen, battery capacity, charging standards, camera hardware, storage, network bands and promised software updates against manufacturer documentation.

## Price and availability

Prices vary by market, storage option, taxes and date. Confirm the live selling price, warranty, launch status and availability with the manufacturer or authorized retailer.

## Buyer checklist

Check regional warranty, supported networks, return policy, update commitments, accessories and repair availability before purchase.

## Verification and limitations

This profile is based on a source directory record. An empty field means the information was not verified, not that a feature or course is unavailable. Figures and specifications may change by country, variant and date. Always confirm on the [source page](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Redmi_Note_4) before applying or buying. Published as a reference guide on 2026-11-11, not as breaking news.

## जरूरी जाँच

निर्माता के दस्तावेजों से सही क्षेत्रीय मॉडल, चिपसेट, स्क्रीन, बैटरी, चार्जिंग, कैमरा, स्टोरेज, नेटवर्क बैंड और सॉफ्टवेयर अपडेट की जानकारी मिलाएँ।

कीमत बाजार, स्टोरेज, टैक्स और तारीख के अनुसार बदलती है। मौजूदा कीमत, वारंटी और उपलब्धता निर्माता या अधिकृत विक्रेता से जाँचें।

खरीदने से पहले स्थानीय वारंटी, नेटवर्क सपोर्ट, वापसी नीति, अपडेट, एक्सेसरीज और मरम्मत की उपलब्धता जाँचें।
